{{Quote|I know what you're thinking: "What dastardly evil could they be unearthing here?" The answer is less sinister than you might assume. We're studying the Temple of Sacrifice, or parts related anyway. In hindsight, I realize that isn't helping my case.|Dr. Talos Drellik explains his mission to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" />}}
An [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] '''expedition''' was led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Talos Drellik]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[3630 BBY]] during the [[War against Zakuul|war]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Drellik led an expedition team to Yavin 4 at the direction of the [[Dark Council]] following up on his hypothesis that mechanisms in the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] may have shared traits with the technology of the Eternal Empire on account of their association with the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. The [[Alliance Commander|leader]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] to defeat Zakuul aided Drellik in recovering artifacts related to the temple scattered across the moon and eventually discovered the ancient [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Ak'ghal Usar]] contained in [[Prison/Legends|stasis]].

==The expedition==
===Recovering artifacts===
{{Quote|The temple was created by the Emperor's design, much like the Eternal Empire. I suspect there could be shared elements in the technology. We're working to exhume functional samples, but the Massassi make the work quite dangerous.|Dr. Talos Drellik explains his hypothesis to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" />}}
[[File:Temple_of_Sacrifice.png|thumb|right|250px|Technology associated with the Temple of Sacrifice (pictured) was the focal point of Dr. Drellik's expedition.]]
Sometime after the disappearance of his master, [[Darth Nox]], at the start of the [[Eternal Empire]]'s galactic [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] in c. [[3636 BBY]]<ref name="3630BBY" />, [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Talos Drellik]] was ordered by the [[Dark Council]] to return to the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] to lead an expedition to the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Drellik's mission was to study the [[Temple of Sacrifice]]'s mechanisms which he theorized may have shared traits with other technology constructed by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], principally that associated with the Eternal Empire.<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" />

Shortly after the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the Eternal Empire was founded [[3630 BBY|five years later]]<ref name="3630BBY" />, their scientific advisor, Dr. [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] commended Drellik to the recently released [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] as a prospective recruit in the [[War against Zakuul|war]] against [[Zakuul]]. On Yavin 4, Drellik offered the Alliance Commander the opportunity to assist him in recovering artifacts from numerous sites across the moon for analysis to discern similarities with Zakuulan technology in exchange for his joining the Alliance.<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" />

===Discovering the Shadow Killer===
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
{{Quote|He took this place as his own and locked me away to protect his precious temple. For all his claims of immortality, his interest in the temple betrays those lies. If it was destroyed, he may be dead, too.|Ak'ghal Usar describes his imprisonment by the Sith Emperor to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" />}}
[[File:Akghal_Usar.png|thumb|left|250px|The Yavin 4 expedition concluded with the discovery of Ak'ghal Usar (pictured), a Dashade Shadow Killer held captive in stasis by the former Sith Emperor for over 300 years.]]
Drellik's Reclamation Service research team remained on the Yavin moon under the direction of Dr. [[Narissa Delau]] to pursue their studies but did not make much progress until the discovery of another artifact in the [[Architect's Hollow]] by expedition member [[Harris (Yavin 4)|Harris]] several months later.<ref name="3630BBY" /> The team discerned that the new relic, like those previously collected, dated to the [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] era and shared other similarities. Further attempts to study the relics ended in disaster when the team was attacked by [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] who killed, wounded, and scattered the team members.

At the request of Dr. Drellik, the Alliance Commander returned to the service's expedition camp and collected the relics and research notes to continue the expedition. After some investigation, the commander encountered a [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] held in [[Prison/Legends|stasis]]. After inadvertently releasing the prisoner and engaging in a brief duel, the prisoner revealed himself as [[Ak'ghal Usar]], a Dashade [[Shadow Killer]] and the Last lord of [[Urkupp]], his species' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Usar had tracked Exar Kun to Yavin 4 over [[3996 BBY|three hundred years earlier]] after the fatal [[Cron Supernova/Legends|destruction]] of his homeworld to exact his vengeance on the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. By the time he arrived, Kun had been [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|defeated]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Usar was later placed in his stasis prison by a black-eyed Sith, recognized by the commander as a reference to the former Sith Emperor. The commander defeated Usar to contain the danger he represented.<ref name="Reclaimed Treasure" />
{{Endgame}}

While in the hidden hollow where Usar's stasis chamber was discovered, the Alliance Commander also found a dormant [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] which was subsequently delivered to Dr. Drellik. Drellik assessed that the holocron was related to two others the pair had discovered during their initial recovery of artifacts across the Yavin moon and resolved to study the matter further.<ref name="Your Recent Discovery">{{TORcite|type=message|Your Recent Discovery|[[Talos Drellik]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|To never taste the anguish of these men leaves me hollow. I crave anything to satiate my rage. So long as you mean harm to my enemies, I shall serve you willingly.|Ak'ghal Usar expresses his desire for vengeance against the Sith Emperor and his son Arcann|<ref name="Reclaimed Treasure" />}}
The Reclamation Service Yavin 4 expedition appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', the fifth Digital Expansion to the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Player characters of any of the eight playable classes learn of and may choose to participate in the expedition after completing the ninth chapter<ref name="KOTFE9">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=9}}</ref> of the expansion and the To Find a Findsman <ref name="To Find a Findsman">{{TORcite|type=general|To Find a Findsman|[[Zakuul]]}}</ref> Alliance Alert mission. Players may assist Talos Drellik in recovering artifacts across Yavin 4 for the option of recruiting him, or may refuse the mission. Sith Inquisitor player characters have class-specific dialogue options and may bypass assisting Drellik on Yavin and recruit him immediately.<ref name="Fighting Power With Knowledge" />

Recruiting Talos Drellik and completing the twelfth chapter<ref name="KOTFE12">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=12}}</ref> of ''Knights of the Fallen Empire'' are required prerequisites to access the Alliance Alert mission Reclaimed Treasure, which makes Ak'ghal Usar available as a companion. After an initial duel and dialogue with Usar, the player character may select the light side option to defeat Usar to contain his quest for vengeance, or the remaining dark side options to recruit Usar into the Alliance or allow him to leave to follow his own path.<ref name="Reclaimed Treasure" />
